channel.title: Pier & Point · Building B
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Building B (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Building B: The Building B page credited its DataSF address source to the Department of Building Inspection; it now credits the City and County of San Francisco (DataSF), as the other address sources on the site do. An open question about the 1051 3rd Street address in a press release was removed, because the page's address entry already says that 1051 3rd Street is not an official address for this parcel.

item.title: Correction · Building B: Building B's record now states: no Nvidia lease commencement date (The Real Deal says only that Nvidia 'is slated to occupy' 45,000 sq ft; the March 2026 start was removed throughout the record); Breakthrough Properties is described as assisting with the life-science real estate, and the 'lab-ready' and 'Tishman Speyer's life-science arm' wording was removed; topping out is stated as by March 7, 2022; four DBI permits now show real filing dates and no 'issued' date; Flour + Water and Ike's openings cite post-opening articles (Appetito, sfbayca.com); LuxFit's opening month is blank and Grey's Florals is shown as announced; MNT Studio remains announced pending confirmation; an earlier permit entry no longer says slabs were demolished; the identification of an earlier lot as the Wharfside building was removed as unsupported; Fort Point Physical Therapy's registration is described as a registration; source titles and dates (Loeb & Loeb, the Warriors article repost, the Dec 2021 memo, the Port disclosure report, The Real Deal) were corrected; and the Jan 30, 2018 approval now cites the Port Commission minutes.
item.description: Building B's record now states: no Nvidia lease commencement date (The Real Deal says only that Nvidia 'is slated to occupy' 45,000 sq ft; the March 2026 start was removed throughout the record); Breakthrough Properties is described as assisting with the life-science real estate, and the 'lab-ready' and 'Tishman Speyer's life-science arm' wording was removed; topping out is stated as by March 7, 2022; four DBI permits now show real filing dates and no 'issued' date; Flour + Water and Ike's openings cite post-opening articles (Appetito, sfbayca.com); LuxFit's opening month is blank and Grey's Florals is shown as announced; MNT Studio remains announced pending confirmation; an earlier permit entry no longer says slabs were demolished; the identification of an earlier lot as the Wharfside building was removed as unsupported; Fort Point Physical Therapy's registration is described as a registration; source titles and dates (Loeb & Loeb, the Warriors article repost, the Dec 2021 memo, the Port disclosure report, The Real Deal) were corrected; and the Jan 30, 2018 approval now cites the Port Commission minutes. Source: The Real Deal, 2025-11-21 (https://therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2025/11/21/nvidia-leases-first-ever-san-francisco-offices/); SF YIMBY, 2022-03-07 (https://sfyimby.com/2022/03/three-of-four-towers-near-topping-out-in-phase-one-of-mission-rock-in-mission-bay-san-francisco.html); Appetito (https://appetitomagazine.com/news/flour-water-pizza-shop-opens-at-mission-rock-in-san-francisco); sfbayca.com (https://sfbayca.com/2024/07/21/from-pop-up-disaster-to-100-locations-ikes-still-serves-something-special/); Port of San Francisco, Minutes of the Special Port Commission Meeting, 2018-01-30 (https://www.sfport.com/media/3353/download).

item.title: Correction · Building B: Mission Rock Building B re-identified. It had earlier been joined to Assessor lot 8719001, a mistaken shape and position match: DataSF's Parcels dataset shows that lot record dropped on 2005-05-31 and lists no address for it. (The earlier text called it the Wharfside building at 185 Berry St; no source was cited for that, so it was removed on 2026-09-29.)
item.description: Mission Rock Building B re-identified. It had earlier been joined to Assessor lot 8719001, a mistaken shape and position match: DataSF's Parcels dataset shows that lot record dropped on 2005-05-31 and lists no address for it. (The earlier text called it the Wharfside building at 185 Berry St; no source was cited for that, so it was removed on 2026-09-29.) Source: Mission Rock Design Controls, Figures 1.1 and 6.2.
